prompts.pillar-prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated mine timber corner support pillar with a small integrated lantern, for Gemventure.
Reference 1 is the approved blue slime: camera, matte finish, thick dark-purple silhouette, broad geometric chamfers and softened corners ONLY; no creature, face, eyes or crystal. Reference 2 is the approved stone wall this post will stand against; match its geometric simplicity and scale of bevels.
Subject: a single tall, thick, perfectly straight square wooden post, with a short chunky horizontal cap beam at its top and two very short angular support knees under the cap. Like a simple T-shaped mine timber support, NOT a doorway or arch. Only a few large cuboid masses. Overall height roughly THREE TIMES overall width; shaft is substantial, roughly half the total cap width. A single small squared lantern is mounted directly onto the FRONT of the post near its upper third, centered, with a simple dark frame and one warm pale-gold luminous inset. Light is readable as a solid warm color; no bloom, halo, floor glow or particles. Lantern must not hang off a long arm. One broad band fastening near the bottom, no nail scatter. Bottom of timber is flat, no stone pedestal or feet.
Camera: elevated near-front orthographic view matching approved slime; broad readable front, narrow darker right-facing plane, small visible top face on cap. Vertical post remains vertical, cap beam's long axis horizontal. No diamond isometry or converging perspective.
Materials: warm ochre/clay/brown timber harmonizing with project palette, darker brown right plane, broad matte softened bevels with intermediate tone. Almost solid color fields; at most ONE broad subtle grain notch on the shaft, no woodgrain texture, no little cracks or fine lines. Restrained slate-purple fastening. Thick dark-purple contour, clean shape readable at 60 pixels tall. Upper-left light.
Transparent PNG background with real alpha, entire isolated object visible with transparent margin. No wall, floor, ground shadow, props, text, labels, watermark or background. Preserve clean simple geometric art, not photorealistic.
prompts.pillar-correction-prompt: Precise object edit of the supplied mine timber post. Keep the wooden shaft, lantern, palette, bevels, camera and simple geometric style exactly. Shorten the horizontal cap beam to about HALF its current length, keeping it centered on the post, and shorten the two knees to fit. The resulting complete pillar must be narrow: roughly three times taller than its total width. Remove ALL purple glow, haze, halo and background, including the purple aura around the silhouette and near the foot. Empty areas must be fully transparent; only the hard clean antialiased silhouette remains, with fully opaque timber and lantern. The warm yellow lantern pane is solid color with no exterior glow. Do not add details or floor. Output the complete isolated pillar on genuine transparent background.
prompts.pillar-extraction-prompt: Background extraction only. Preserve the attached wooden pillar and lantern exactly. REMOVE the entire soft purple/brown luminous aura surrounding it, including every faint translucent haze pixel outside the dark hard outline. Keep only the crisp opaque object with a normal antialiased edge. True alpha transparency around the silhouette and in the holes beneath the beam; no black painted backdrop, no purple backdrop, no glow at all. The lantern is a solid yellow pane and must not cast any exterior halo. Do not redraw, change proportions, or add any element.
prompts.stone-cap-prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create an opaque seamless material for the NARROW TOP CUT EDGE of the attached Gemventure stone wall. This is a quiet blue-gray continuous bedrock slab, seen directly from above. Preserve the wall reference's matte blue-gray/lavender stone palette, large softened geometric planes and gentle broad tonal transitions. The top must look DIFFERENT from the front face: no rows of rocks, no bricks, no dark outlines around stones, no pictured wall fronts, no beveled cuboids repeated like cobblestones. Instead ONE continuous rocky surface with only three or four very large angular subdued color fields and one very broad shallow slab transition. Low contrast. No fine grain, cracks, dots, pebbles, glossy highlights or tiny facets. Entire canvas filled edge to edge; seamless repeating in both directions. Landscape 2:1. No object silhouette, border, transparency, labels or scene. This is a sparse hand-painted cartoon game material, not a photograph.
prompts.stone-cap-dark-prompt: Precise color edit ONLY of this quiet continuous slab material. Preserve its few large planar fields and subtle angular transitions exactly; add no details or joints. Recolor the entire material to dark muted gray-purple very close to game floor #353658. Base slab about #41435d, subdued light planes about #4b4d65, darker planes #35364f. Overall dark slate appearance, no pale silver, no icy blue, no white. This is the thin top of a stone cave wall, it must blend with the dark floor and dark wall fronts. Preserve edge-to-edge opaque seamless texture. No outlines around individual fields, no cracks, no new geometry or text.
prompts.stone-face-dark-prompt: Precise color edit ONLY of this seamless Gemventure stone WALL FACE texture. Preserve every stone shape, joint, bevel, arrangement, pixel composition and matte rendering. Recolor the entire stone material much darker and less blue, to harmonize closely with the game's floor whose exact base color is #353658 (dark muted gray-purple). Main large front faces should be close to #3d3e59; broad lit bevels around #50536b; darker sides around #2c2d46; deep joints #180d2f. These are art targets, not a demand for posterization. Keep quiet intermediate tones, subtle smooth transitions and readable geometric planes. Overall luminosity close to the dark slate floor, NOT pale silver or light icy blue. No white highlights. Preserve edge-to-edge opaque texture, its horizontal seamless repeat and two courses. Do not add or remove details, do not change the geometry, no margins, no text. This is a material recolor only.
